deletionRecordGap.finding: Before M22.5 there was no durable record that a memory had been deleted: Brain.forgetMemory wrote a trace entry (in-memory, dev only) with a truncated id and no text.
deletionRecordGap.consequence: For a deletion that happened before this build, no stored artifact can prove which text belonged to the deleted record. The migration therefore does not guess: it quarantines legacy auto-checkpoints for review.
deletionRecordGap.mitigation: From this build on, every deletion records hashed windows (DeletionLedger), so residue written later by any subsystem is identifiable.
deletionRecordGap.verified: M22.5 test B (ledger has no plaintext); browser evidence: a pre-ledger copy could only be reached through explicit review
